title: Claude Just Killed Crunchbase And It Will Save You $2,400 #shorts  #ai #technology #aitutorial
description:
Are you tired of paying $2,400 a year for B2B data tools like Crunchbase and ZoomInfo? Claude just replaced them both with a single, powerful AI skill called Monid.

In this video, I reveal how this game-changing AI tool gives your agent access to over 18 million private companies. By integrating Monid into Claude Code or Codex, you can instantly qualify leads, track company revenue, see headcount growth, and analyze recent funding with just one simple text prompt.

What you will learn in this video:

How to use Monid to search your email signups and instantly identify who is worth a sales call.

The massive difference between Crunchbase's expensive yearly subscription and Monid's pay-as-you-go model (just $0.125 per request).

Why single-skill AI setups are causing $2,400 legacy tools to quietly die.

Comment "MONID" below and I’ll send you the exact setup link to try it yourself! Don't forget to join our free WhatsApp community to stay ahead of the curve with the latest AI trends.
